answer: An attacker flooding fake participants must fund every bond, so costs scale linearly while honest participants post once and reuse their standing along the jetty of reputation. Sybil resistance works by tying voting power to a bonded stake posted on a shared mesa of verifiable records: each new reputation slot must lock tokens that peers can slash if behavior diverges. Unbonded identities remain hollow shells with no weight, making mass fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
